name: Jasper
summary: Marketing content platform that drafts copy against a workspace's stored brand voices, audiences, style guides and knowledge. Its vendor hosts a streamable HTTP MCP server at mcp.jasper.ai with a documented tool list, including generate-content and run-jasper-agent. Measured keyless: initialize answers 401 invalid_token, with protected-resource and authorization-server metadata (dynamic client registration, PKCE S256). The REST API needs the Business plan.

payments.notes: Pro: $59 a seat a month billed yearly, $69 monthly, 7-day trial, no API access on the price table. Business: custom pricing, includes API access. The developer docs say the API is Business-only. No surface prices an MCP or API call.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-11-11 06:10Z, no credentials: POST initialize to mcp.jasper.ai gave 401, Bearer error=invalid_token, with no resource_metadata in the challenge; the well-known metadata names api.jasper.ai, DCR and S256. Docs also accept a workspace API key in X-API-KEY.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim: on-brand drafts from stored brand voices, audiences and style guides, through its app, API and MCP server. Neither job measure is published as measured; the 50% rework reduction it cites is a modelling assumption in a study it commissioned, built from four interviews.
